items.title_zh: IFS 官员要求用户区分捷豹和豹。你能认出猫吗？
items.title_en: IFS Officer Asks Users to Differentiate Between Jaguar and Leopard. Can You Identify the Cats?
items.summary_zh: 印度林务局官员在推特上分享了两张这些雄伟动物的照片，并要求用户区分豹子和美洲虎。看看“知识渊博”的观众有何反应！
items.summary_en: Indian Forest Service Officer shared a tweet with two pics of the majestic animals and asked users to differentiate between the leopard and the jaguar. See how the 'knowledgeable' audience reacted!
